_comment: Source of truth for building Training-Material courses. A course is seed-eligible ONLY when include=true AND every required condition resolves to 'met'. Doubtful courses are excluded with a reason. course_tracker.py evaluates this against disk + the youtube/answer-key inputs and gates seeding. Paths are relative to material_root (see tracker).

courses.exclude_reason: No QA-Officer exam exists. Its quiz_form is the SAME file used by quality-assurance-process, whose questions cover the QA process (project initiation, GAP assessment, CDR, MRM), not the 7 QP procedures. The 2026 drop re-sent that identical form as folder 11, so nothing new arrived. Needs a QP-scoped exam from the client, or a decision to drop this course as a duplicate of quality-assurance-process.
